relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine exemplifies this approach as a state-dependent, highly selective, and potent inhibitor of Nav1.8.

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine achieves specificity by allosterically binding to the extracellular S3–S4 loop of the second voltage‐sensing domain (VSD2) in the Nav1.8 α‐subunit (Figure 1).

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine demonstrated a significant reduction in acute pain following abdominoplasty or bunionectomy when compared to placebo.

relationships.subject: CYP3A
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine is primarily metabolized by CYP3A enzymes, resulting in the formation of M6‐SUZ, an active metabolite that is approximately 3.7 times less potent than its parent compound in inhibiting Nav1.8.

key_findings: Suzetrigine is a state-dependent allosteric Nav1.8 inhibitor with IC50 0.68 nM and >31,000-fold selectivity, binding VSD2 S3-S4 loop.
Phase II/III trials show reduced acute postoperative pain comparable to hydrocodone/acetaminophen; no benefit over placebo in lumbosacral radiculopathy phase II.
